name: room-probes-journey
description: R7-L before/after. ONE session, two boots (?ff=roomProbes:off then :on), the project's calibrated walk poses in the kitchen, both bathrooms and the living/dining, 13:00 pinned, realistic/capable. The OFF arm is the in-session control — never compare against a stale /tmp frame.

steps.name: setup-off
steps.eval: (() => { try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.dismissChecklist?.(); s.setTimeMode?.('manual'); s.setManualHour?.(13); s.setLightsMode?.('off'); s.setQualityTier?.('realistic'); s.setDeviceClass?.('capable'); s.hideLoading?.() })()

steps.name: pin-device-class-off
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store; s.getState().setDeviceClass('capable'); s.setState({ setDeviceClass: () => {} }) })()

steps.name: assert-control-arm
steps.eval: (() => { const on = window.__store.getState().featureFlags.roomProbes; if (on !== false) throw new Error('control arm is NOT off: roomProbes=' + on) })()

steps.name: enter-walk-off
steps.eval: window.__store.getState().setCameraMode('firstPerson')

steps.name: hide-hud-off
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); s.hideLoading?.(); s.dismissCallout?.('walk-mode'); s.dismissCallout?.('walk-move'); s.dismissChecklist?.() })()

steps.name: p-off-kitchen-counter
steps.eval: (() => { const l = window.__walkLook; l.setPosition(8.8, 7.4); l.setYaw(2.05); l.setPitch(-0.05) })()

steps.name: p-off-kitchen-floor
steps.eval: (() => { const l = window.__walkLook; l.setPosition(8.8, 7.4); l.setYaw(2.05); l.setPitch(-0.6) })()

steps.name: p-off-bath1-window
steps.eval: (() => { const l = window.__walkLook; l.setPosition(2.69, 5.3); l.setYaw(3.1416); l.setPitch(-0.05) })()

steps.name: p-off-bath2-door
steps.eval: (() => { const l = window.__walkLook; l.setPosition(4.3, 5.1); l.setYaw(-2.535); l.setPitch(-0.05) })()

steps.name: p-off-living-window
steps.eval: (() => { const l = window.__walkLook; l.setPosition(10.9, 5.2); l.setYaw(0); l.setPitch(-0.05) })()

steps.name: cost-off
steps.eval: (() => { const gl = window.__three.gl; const a = window.__three.advance; for (let i = 0; i < 15; i++) a(performance.now() / 1000, true); const t0 = performance.now(); for (let i = 0; i < 60; i++) a(performance.now() / 1000, true); const ms = (performance.now() - t0) / 60; console.log('[probe] ARM=off frameMs=' + ms.toFixed(2) + ' programs=' + gl.info.programs.length + ' textures=' + gl.info.memory.textures + ' geometries=' + gl.info.memory.geometries) })()

steps.name: setup-on
steps.eval: (() => { try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.dismissChecklist?.(); s.setTimeMode?.('manual'); s.setManualHour?.(13); s.setLightsMode?.('off'); s.setQualityTier?.('realistic'); s.setDeviceClass?.('capable'); s.hideLoading?.() })()

steps.name: pin-device-class-on
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store; s.getState().setDeviceClass('capable'); s.setState({ setDeviceClass: () => {} }) })()

steps.name: assert-test-arm
steps.eval: (() => { const on = window.__store.getState().featureFlags.roomProbes; if (on !== true) throw new Error('test arm is NOT on: roomProbes=' + on) })()

steps.name: enter-walk-on
steps.eval: window.__store.getState().setCameraMode('firstPerson')

steps.name: hide-hud-on
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); s.hideLoading?.(); s.dismissCallout?.('walk-mode'); s.dismissCallout?.('walk-move'); s.dismissChecklist?.() })()

steps.name: assert-probes-attached
steps.eval: (() => { let n = 0; window.__three.scene.traverse((o) => { const m = o.material; if (m && !Array.isArray(m) && m.userData && m.userData.roomProbeRecord) n++ }); console.log('[probe] attached materials=' + n); if (n === 0) throw new Error('roomProbes on, but NOTHING is patched — the feature is inert') })()

steps.name: p-on-kitchen-counter
steps.eval: (() => { const l = window.__walkLook; l.setPosition(8.8, 7.4); l.setYaw(2.05); l.setPitch(-0.05) })()

steps.eval: (() => { const l = window.__walkLook; l.setPosition(4.3, 5.1); l.setYaw(-2.535); l.setPitch(-0.05) })()

steps.eval: (() => { const gl = window.__three.gl; const a = window.__three.advance; for (let i = 0; i < 15; i++) a(performance.now() / 1000, true); const t0 = performance.now(); for (let i = 0; i < 60; i++) a(performance.now() / 1000, true); const ms = (performance.now() - t0) / 60; console.log('[probe] ARM=on frameMs=' + ms.toFixed(2) + ' programs=' + gl.info.programs.length + ' textures=' + gl.info.memory.textures + ' geometries=' + gl.info.memory.geometries) })()
